scale_reasoning: a small desk lamp: 18.4 cm weighted base, 34 cm stem, hinge with a through bolt, cone shade 15 cm long with a rolled lip, a cable, about 39 cm tall. Measured 30.57 x 39.1 x 18.4 cm (x, up, y); the planned envelope per axis is 20-32 cm, 17-20 cm, 34-46 cm (x, y, z up).
textures: 3 PNGs: one 1024 px atlas (desk_lamp_atlas_basecolor, _orm with R occlusion, G roughness, B metal, and a tangent-space OpenGL _normal), baked with Cycles on the CPU in scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy from layered bake-source materials (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, room-scale grunge, AO (also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55, as the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set: smart projection, islands at one texel density, hidden faces (book sides inside a row, undersides) shrunk to 0.12, 1525 px/m on the visible surface (0.1442 m2 visible, 7% of the surface hidden). Bake seconds: {"base":1.28,"rough":1.22,"metal":0.64,"normal":1.35,"ao":7.62}. Flat colour, no texture: lamp_shade_glow (emissive, UE drives it). GLB embeds the atlas as PNG.

finish.bevel: angle-limited (30 degrees) bevel on every primitive's hard edges, width per part (0.5 to 3 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, clamped, hardened normals, then a weighted normal (face area, keep sharp) and smooth shading; 1678 hard edges bevelled, 124 kept sharp by design (paper edges, spiral roll ends, small screws), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded (inside other parts or at acute corners)
